trust_decision.summary: Whether a route's request-part schema (body/querystring/params/headers) gets compiled into a validator is decided by truthiness of the schema value, so the valid JSON Schema boolean `false` (deny-all) is treated as 'no schema' and the request reaches the handler unvalidated.

landing_point.why: compileSchemasForValidation is the function that turns route schemas into validators; `if (schema.body)` is the first truthiness gate a reader of 'skipped boolean false schemas' would grep for.
